newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in sluggish after-hours trade, as private investors retreated to the sidelines ahead of the spot expiry on Friday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen higher from the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.2 yen firmer at 135.4 yen. Volume was 4,054 lots.

During the day, prices drifted within tight ranges in directionless trade. "The market was focusing on the expiry on Friday. The market expected the spot October to expire steady with a large number of deliveries," one trader said.
